tests.name: Chinese typing shows clickable candidates; selecting a word replaces only preedit
Space selects first candidate; Enter retains literal spelling without submitting the dialog
Backspace edits preedit; confirmation reads committed text; punctuation follows the chosen word
Input edit callbacks can read text without breaking preedit; old candidate callbacks cannot commit a new query
Candidate paging clears stale hits and boundary pages stay bounded
Separate input boxes never share composition; cursor motion commits before moving
Switching Chinese to English keeps quick switch available and reentering Chinese creates fresh state
Password and numeric fields do not run either Chinese IME or candidate UI
External pinyin plugin and explicit opt-out keep the native layout intact
Candidate UI fits viewport, stays above native keys and does not cover dialog buttons
Input and stock screensaver settings are scoped; global search finds the new input route
Missing or empty stock image directories never change current settings
Stock image activation and preview use local artwork; restoration preserves later user changes
Settings write failure rolls back stock configuration
Final owner detach restores keyboard hooks and closed dialog candidates cannot type
